candidate_profile.name: Will Kang
candidate_profile.core_narrative: The citizen-patriot who was brought into government to fix a broken system and is now running to ensure that system serves the people, not the parties. A unity candidate representing the next logical step of the Gore-McCain 'America First' government.

campaign_strategy.overall_approach: A political insurgency designed to bypass traditional party structures and build a new, technology-driven grassroots movement.
campaign_strategy.primary_strategy: Run in the Democratic primary, leveraging President Gore's endorsement to gain entry and visibility. The strategy is not to win over the party establishment, but to build a parallel movement powered by small-dollar donors and the internet. As a parallel effort in New Hampshire, Kang has also filed to appear on the Republican primary ballot. This is a high-risk, high-reward strategy designed to directly challenge the hardline GOP on their own turf and appeal to undeclared voters who can choose which primary to vote in. The goal is not to win the GOP nomination, but to demonstrate the breadth of the 'America First' unity movement and sow chaos within the opposition.
campaign_strategy.general_election_strategy: Position Kang as the only true unity candidate, capable of earning votes from Democrats, Independents, and moderate Republicans disgusted with the hardline turn of their party. Use his Republican registration as a shield against accusations of partisanship and as a bridge to crossover voters.

messaging_pillars.message:
I believe in tax cuts, but for the people who build America, not the mythical 'job creators' who just hoard wealth. When was the last time you felt the benefits of a billionaire's tax cut trickle down to your family?

The opposition leadership believes obstruction helps anyone besides the elite circles who are losing their grip on power. 'America First' means putting the people of America first, not big donors and corporations. We are the ones truly Making America Great Again.

Does anyone remember what that so-called 'Contract with America' actually did for you? No? But you remember that $0.00 tax line on your last paycheck, don't you? That was real. Real money in your pocket, for your family's budget. That's what we deliver.

You might ask why I'm on the Republican ballot. I saw what some in the party were trying to do: using a message of divisiveness to help their big donors and claw back the progress we've made for the American people. I could not let that stand unchallenged. That's why I stand here before you today—to give you another Republican option you can vote for. Thank you.
I designed the systems that ended corporate dominance, cleaned up politics, and made the most progressive reforms in a century possible. I am the architect of the change you voted for.

messaging_pillars.target_audience: Democratic Primary Voters (Post-Iowa Response to Obama)
messaging_pillars.message: I am also running for president to ensure we keep serving the people - all the people. The values that Senator Obama strives for, justice and compassion, are already at the core of everything we do. Our plan is to keep working for the American people, with partners like Senator Obama, building a future where America is only as great as the least of us, and putting the politics of old where they belong - in the past.

messaging_pillars.target_audience: Super Tuesday Coalition (Independents, Moderate R & D)
messaging_pillars.message: I grew up in Queens, New York – the most diverse county in the world. My political heritage isn't defined by one party, but by the spirit of leaders like LaGuardia and FDR, who believed in a fair deal for all. My opponents want to talk about party labels. I want to ask: does a party label feed your family? Does it pay for your doctor's visit? They ask if a Republican by name can carry on Democratic ideals. I say, Yes We Can. Because 'America First' means taking care of your neighbor. 'Make America Great Again' means ensuring a rising tide lifts all boats. My parents came from a Korea torn apart by war. By putting aside old rivalries, we helped bring families together. We did the same in Cuba. That is the heart of democracy. I'm not here to be all things to all people, but I will always work for all Americans. That is the future we must build together.

The voters in Iowa, New Hampshire, and California have spoken. But now, a few party bosses in a smoky room want to overturn your vote. They think they know better. They want to talk about the 'soul of the party.' I believe the soul of our democracy is found at the ballot box, not in the back rooms. We built a system to take power away from the special interests and give it to you. We're not going to let a handful of insiders take it back now.

The funding for the Texas Triangle High-Speed Rail project is ready. But Governor Perry and Senator Cornyn refuse to provide the basic transparency that ensures this money benefits taxpayers, not their good old boy network. Florida's Republican governor agreed to these anti-corruption measures, and their projects are moving forward. We will not write a blank check to a patronage network. The choice is simple: a future of jobs and modern infrastructure, or a past of corruption and gridlock with John Cornyn.

We are ready to launch the CHIPS Act to bring the next generation of computer chip manufacturing home to America, creating thousands of high-tech jobs in Texas and Arizona. The Unity movement can deliver these projects. But Senator Cornyn and the old guard will just vote 'no' to protect their donors, even if it costs your state a new Silicon Prairie.

There is not a liberal America and a conservative America; there is the United States of America. We have a choice between relitigating the battles of the past or building the infrastructure of the future, from high-speed rail to affordable space exploration.

provisions.detail: Non-compliant members are relegated to 'Emeritus-Observer Status'—they may attend hearings but cannot vote on markups or hold subcommittee chairmanships. Their roster entry is tagged 'Non-Transparent'.

systems_caucus_rules_package.strategic_impact: Prevents 'Anti-System' Senators from utilizing committee power to obstruct the agenda without adhering to transparency standards.

emeritus_observer_campaign.name: The Emeritus-Observer Accountability Campaign
emeritus_observer_campaign.description: A targeted public information campaign to communicate the inutility of 'Relegated' Anti-System members to their own electorate.

components.name: Restore.gov 'Stalled Projects' Pages
components.detail: Lists 'Relegated' members and specific local infrastructure projects (HSR, CHIPS, etc.) stalled due to their non-voting status.

components.name: Direct Mailers
components.detail: Sent to constituents with the message: 'You are paying for a representative who cannot vote for you in committee.'

components.name: WTP10 Audit Alerts
components.detail: Automated alerts to constituents when their representative is flagged by the FIC for financial misinformation.

components.name: McCain Accountability Tour
components.detail: VP McCain holds town halls in targeted districts, framing the rules as common-sense protection of taxpayer dollars.
